biggest_catch: There are zero guaranteed tasks — you set your own hourly rate and keep 100% of it, but clients choose among many Taskers, work is irregular, and online/remote categories (virtual assistance, data entry, writing) are the most competitive.
catches: Zero guaranteed jobs: task volume varies by market, category, and season; reviews and ratings decide who gets booked.

Taskers keep 100% of their set hourly rate plus 100% of expenses and tips, but clients pay the Taskrabbit Service Fee and Trust & Support fee on top of your rate — higher platform fees make your quote look more expensive than it is (exact fee percentages are not published on the official support pages).
Taskers are independent contractors: no benefits, no guaranteed minimum, and you're responsible for your own taxes.
You must submit an invoice through the app after each task and wait for payment processing via direct bank deposit (a few business days); there is no instant cash-out to hand.
Remote/online task categories are competitive and often price-driven — beginners report $20-$40/hour typical ranges, not a promise.
Registration requires an application, ID/background verification, and in-app onboarding before you can accept tasks.
Cancellations, no-shows, and bad reviews directly cut future bookings.

steps: Download the Taskrabbit Tasker app and create a tasker account, selecting categories you can actually do — for online work, virtual assistance, data entry, or writing/editing.
Complete ID and background verification and finish onboarding before you can accept tasks.
Set your own hourly rate and availability/schedule; research what other Taskers charge in your category so you price competitively without racing to the bottom.
Accept task invitations, complete the work, and submit your invoice through the app immediately after finishing.
Link your checking account for direct deposit; payment arrives within a few business days after the invoice is processed.
Collect 5-star reviews on every job — ratings are what drive future bookings since nothing is guaranteed.
Expenses are reimbursed at 100% and tips go entirely to you, so document any out-of-pocket costs in the app.
timing: Paid via direct bank deposit after you submit an invoice through the app; typically a few business days after task completion.
